description.p: Risuko downloads files from the web, torrents and more. Paste a link or a magnet, or open a .torrent file, and Risuko splits the download across connections and resumes it after interruptions.

ul.li: HTTP and HTTPS, with multiple connections and mirror failover
BitTorrent and magnet links, including v2 torrents, DHT and peer exchange
Usenet NZB files, with PAR2 repair

description.p: Risuko can also follow RSS feeds and download new items automatically, upload finished files to WebDAV, S3, SFTP or FTP servers, and be controlled remotely through an aria2-compatible RPC interface.

ul.li: feat(bt): BEP audit fixes, add BEP 24/40/42 and uTP over IPv6

description.p: feat: detect copied links on focus under Wayland, cache Rust builds in R2
Fixes a crash when showing desktop notifications on Linux.
This release reworks the BitTorrent engine and secures remote control.

ul.li: More reliable BitTorrent downloads, with a stricter endgame, a session-wide connection limit and bans for peers that send corrupt data
One speed limit shared by HTTP, BitTorrent, ed2k and Usenet downloads, applied without a restart
ed2k downloads resume from partial files and support files larger than 4 GiB
The RPC server now requires a secret, generated on first run
BitTorrent listens on port 21301 by default
